prs.author: demoray

members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: HTTP errors in the streamable-HTTP POST path crash or hang the caller instead of returning a JSON-RPC error response. Both PRs convert HTTP failures into SessionMessage(JSONRPCError(...)) sent to ctx.read_stream_writer, so the caller receives a structured error rather than an unhandled exception or silent hang. (2 PRs)

members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2613 handles the error at the HTTP response level (status >= 400 in _handle_post_request), includes updated tests in test_streamable_http.py, and imports INTERNAL_ERROR from mcp.types for a canonical error code. PR #2607 catches httpx.HTTPError one layer up (in handle_request_async), which is coarser and does not cover non-exception HTTP errors; it also ships without test coverage.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2637 contains the substantive fix — changing concurrent anyio task-group teardown to sequential awaits so AnyIO task contexts are preserved and errors propagate — plus accompanying tests that exercise the path. PR #2711 only removes the `# pragma: no cover` markers from the same two methods; that cleanup is a natural consequence of #2637 adding test coverage for those methods, making #2711 redundant once #2637 lands.

members.title: fix: send SEP-2243 streamable HTTP headers
members.author: he-yufeng
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2730: SEP-2243 requires the client to send Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name headers on every request so servers can route/log by method without parsing the body. Both PRs add the MCP_METHOD and MCP_NAME constants and extend _prepare_headers to populate them.
